name: Italian Marinated Chicken
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix broth, tomatoes, cheese, Italian seasoning and garlic powder in a shallow non-metallic dish. Reserve half of this mixture.
Add chicken to remaining marinade and turn to coat.
Remove chicken from broth mixture. Discard the marinade.
Grill or broil chicken for 15 minutes or until done, turning and brushing often with reserved broth mixture.
